title: Labor Trafficking Indicators in Agriculture
body: This public report describes labor trafficking patterns in agriculture across multiple states. It highlights coercion language, debt bondage, recruitment pressure, and law enforcement investigations tied to cross-border movement and exploitation risks.

title: Sex Trafficking Risk Signals in Hospitality
body: The report documents sex trafficking indicators, recruitment vectors, violence, and coordinated investigations. It references survivor support channels, jurisdiction overlap, and law enforcement reporting used for public awareness and prevention.
